message.content: {"hts_code": "6306.22.9000", "reason": "The retractable screen is a finished textile article of fiberglass/PVC-coated woven fabric with mounting hardware, and while it could arguably fall under awnings/blinds (6303) or a fabric-based sunshade classification, the closest fit for a woven fiberglass insect/light screening assembly is HTSUS 6306.22.9000 (tents, awnings, and sunblinds of man-made fibers, other), though this should be verified against the 6303 and 6306 subheadings and General Rules of Interpretation."}

predicted_reason: The retractable screen is a finished textile article of fiberglass/PVC-coated woven fabric with mounting hardware, and while it could arguably fall under awnings/blinds (6303) or a fabric-based sunshade classification, the closest fit for a woven fiberglass insect/light screening assembly is HTSUS 6306.22.9000 (tents, awnings, and sunblinds of man-made fibers, other), though this should be verified against the 6303 and 6306 subheadings and General Rules of Interpretation.
